away.summary: The Dallas Stars snapped a 0-2-0 start with a dominant 5-0 shutout win over the San Jose Sharks, breaking their early-season slump with an offensive outburst. Jake Oettinger earned his 17th career shutout, making 13 saves and receiving strong support from the team's increased net-front presence and shot generation. The Stars outshot San Jose 26-13 and dominated shot attempts 66-24, showing improved consistency after two subpar outings.

out.detail: Injured (sports hernia), two weeks from return per coach Lindy Ruff

home.summary: The Buffalo Sabres are set to start Colten Ellis in net for his season debut, with the team making lineup adjustments from their 4-3 win over Chicago, including Justin Danforth returning after missing time since Oct. 15. The Sabres have generated offense well, outshooting opponents 54-38 and owning a 63.7% share of scoring chances, but have struggled on the power play (0-for-8 to start the season). They face a tough test against the 2-0-0 Wild, who have outscored opponents 7-2 to begin the year.
